title: Tesla's new partnership: Swedish company Einride to deploy 500 Tesla semi-truck EVs
summary: Tesla (TSLA) is partnering with Swedish trucking company Einride (ENRD), which is deploying 500 of Tesla's electric semi-trucks. Yahoo Finance's Julie Hyman explains the details.

title: What does Tesla's Cybercab launch mean for SpaceX's own ambitions?
summary: Tesla (TSLA) showcased its new Cybercab — a version of its autonomous robotaxi without a steering wheel — ahead of its planned launch in Austin, Texas. Morning Brief Host Julie Hyman is joined by Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley and Barron's associate editor Al Root to discuss this story and what it could represent for Elon Musk's ambitions for SpaceX.

title: This Stock Popped, Then Dropped on Its Big Plans for the Tesla Semi Truck
summary: Tuesday was wild for  Einride  The small-cap stock soared, then dropped after the Swedish trucking firm announced plans for “the world’s largest  Tesla  Semi deployment.”  The Tesla Semi truck was introduced in 2017.  Hundreds have been built, with mass production starting this year.
